html:
Updated 24 Nov 2026 to match the working prototype as built. New items are marked GreenNEW and changed items BlueUPDATED. The main additions are:

  • MSC Analysis on the Review and Feedback page, with three tabs: MSC Summary, MSC Integrity Check (1-10 score, PASS/FAIL) and Journal Fitment %, plus a 6-colour highlight palette (PR #1).

  • An app-wide processing spinner, and a refresh icon beside a reviewer whose invitation is pending, to recheck whether it was accepted (PR #2).

  • Reviewer invitation e-mails with accept/decline, Assign to PE decision, dashboard tabs, paging and the collapsible KPIs & Metrics panel, Usage Metrics with an audit trail, journal cover thumbnails, the organized MSC preview and the ACS Publications theme.

The Story Map and the Design Thinking Point of View for the Author and Editor (Triage and Routing) personas follow the specifications.

• GreenNEW As soon as the MSC is chosen, and before the integrity check runs, show the uploaded MSC read-only in an organized preview pane (title page with title, authors, affiliations, corresponding author and ORCID, then each section, figures, tables and references) so the Author can confirm the right file was picked

  • GreenNEW Show the current-issue cover thumbnail of the selected journal next to the journal dropdown and beside the integrity score. Clicking it opens the journal home page on pubs.acs.org; a drawn placeholder is shown if the image cannot load

  • GreenNEW Each issue in the feedback is ranked critical / major / minor and carries How to fix guidance. Two or more critical issues cap the score at 5, and a similarity above 25% caps it at 4

  • GreenNEW My submissions lists the Author’s MSCs with status, final decision and reviewer feedback. After a Revise decision the Author uploads the revision there, and it goes through the same integrity check before it is re-submitted

after: and the reviewer can be selected for the MSC assignment
html:
• GreenNEW The Assigned Reviewer column shows the reviewer’s e-mail address, the invitation status (Invited / Accepted) and a link to the invitation e-mail that was sent

  • GreenNEW While a reviewer’s invitation is pending, a ⟳ refresh icon appears beside the reviewer name. Clicking it re-checks whether the invitation was accepted and enables Review straight away if it was. The icon is hidden once the invitation is accepted

• GreenNEW Split the MSC table into two tabs, Open & In Progress (default) and Complete, each with a live count. The Time Elapsed chart and filter only consider Open / In Progress MSCs

  • GreenNEW Keep the KPI tiles (MSC count, Open, In Progress, Complete, delayed, unassigned, average fulfillment, average integrity score) visible at the top, and place the charts in a collapsible KPIs & Metrics panel that is collapsed by default and remembers its state. Charts include MSCs received today and the MSC processing outcome by week or month; clicking a chart segment applies the matching filter

  • GreenNEW Show 20 records per page by default, with a 20 / 50 / 100 selector and a pager

  • BlueUPDATED Enable the Review button and the MSC ID link only once a reviewer is assigned and has accepted the invitation. The server refuses review actions until then

after: Editor can select a particular reviewer and assign it to the MSC
html:
• BlueUPDATED Show each reviewer’s e-mail address beside the name. Reviewers are ranked by availability (free capacity, active reviews, leave status), expertise in the journal’s scope and average turnaround, and the top available reviewer is marked Recommended

  • GreenNEW Assigning a reviewer sends an invitation e-mail with a secret accept / decline link (simulated outbox in the prototype). The modal shows the e-mail that was sent

  • GreenNEW Review & Annotate stays locked until the reviewer accepts. A decline frees the MSC for another reviewer, and re-sending or choosing another reviewer replaces the old link, which then stops working

  • GreenNEW While the invitation is pending, the same ⟳ refresh icon is shown beside the reviewer in the modal and on the locked review page

after: Reviewers can also underline and highlight the text
html:
• GreenNEW Offer a highlight colour palette with 6 colours (yellow, green, sky blue, pink, orange, lavender). The colour is stored per annotation, remembered for the next highlight, can be changed from the annotation list, and the list can be filtered by colour

  • GreenNEW An MSC Analysis button in the page header opens a modal that disables the page behind it (close with ✕, Close or Esc). It has three tabs:

    1. MSC Summary: a one-sentence summary and a structured summary (overview, background and objective, approach, key findings, conclusions) taken from the MSC’s own sections, with composition tiles (words, reading time, figures, tables, equations, references)

    2. MSC Integrity Check: the same rules as the Author upload check (7 weighted parameters, caps, PASS above 6), showing the 1-10 score with PASS / FAIL, a chart by parameter and reviewer guidance

    3. Journal Fitment: the % fit of the MSC with the journal chosen at upload, the evidence behind it, a portfolio chart of the fit across journals and feedback

    4. Findings and fitment feedback can be added to the reviewer’s general feedback with one click

  • GreenNEW Show the journal cover thumbnail in the page header, linking to the journal on pubs.acs.org

  • GreenNEW Track review progress from reading progress (up to 90%); a decision completes it (100%). Opening the page moves an Open MSC to In Progress and records the review start time

after: Revision can either be a minor or a major revision
html: • GreenNEW Add a fifth decision, ASSIGN TO PE, which hands the MSC to a selected Publishing Editor for production. It appears in the dashboard filters, charts and tables and in the Author’s My submissions list

• GreenNEW Common Capabilities (all views)

    1. GreenNEW Processing spinner: every page shows a small Processing… / Loading… / Uploading and processing… spinner at the top of the screen whenever a server request is in flight (login, uploads and integrity checks, dashboard loads, reviewer look-ups, invitations, annotations, decisions, MSC analysis, metrics)

    2. GreenNEW Usage Metrics page (link beside Log out): sessions with a pseudonymous user footprint, IP, approximate location, OS / browser, duration of stay and pages visited, with KPIs, charts, a period selector and CSV export

    3. GreenNEW Audit trail: an append-only log of logins, page views, integrity checks, submissions, invitations sent / viewed / accepted / declined, review starts, annotations, decisions and exports, each with time, user, IP and OS

    4. GreenNEW ACS Publications theme: the UI follows the pubs.acs.org look (blue top bar with gold active underline, white masthead, Roboto typography, square buttons and panels)

    5. GreenNEW Demo data: about 75 seeded MSCs built from sample manuscripts (about 50 Open / In Progress with on-track, attention and delayed times, about 25 review-complete), 4 editors, 15 reviewers and 3 Publishing Editors
